title: fix(service-datasource)!: reconnect requires `previous`, and the engine read-back answers the stored driver id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiEe1mThB51wBSHAzPk8xmuG)_

**Fable review owed.** This PR was built on Opus while the Fable quota was out (maintainer order: finish on Opus, then wait for the contract review). It touches `packages/spec/src/**`, so it does not land until a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` contract review record PASS is on its current head.

Fixes #27727 (epic #27261). The four should-fixes and the prose note from the contract review of PR #27715 (6508089206, ④ and ③). Claim 6509213861.

## What changes

- `IDataEngine.registerDatasourceDef?` member doc (`packages/spec/src/contracts/data-engine.ts`): "last write wins, except an absent `driver` keeps the id stored before it", so the member doc and the `EngineDatasourceDef.driver` key doc no longer disagree. The engine's own `registerDatasourceDef` doc says the same. The key doc now also says the read-back answers the stored id.
- `ObjectQL.listDatasourceDefs` answers each definition's stored `driver` id when it has one (chosen over documenting the omission: the id is what decides the floor, so a sweep asking which datasources name a plugin driver can now be written against the contract). A definition that never named a driver is listed without the key, as before; the existing `toEqual` pins carry no driver and are unchanged.
- `DatasourceConnectionService.reconnect`: `opts.previous` is required (type level), and a call without `previous.driver` (absent or empty) is refused at runtime BEFORE anything is evicted or rebuilt, so the live pool keeps serving. Before this, a host calling `reconnect` without `previous` got a kept pool restored under a definition naming no driver, which serves a plugin driver unfloored, silently. Both in-repo callers (the admin plugin's `reregisterPool` and two test seams) already pass it.
- `external-driver-floor.test.ts`: the #27277 keep test now names the caller class it models (a registration of the write-gate facts only) and says the connection service is not that caller.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx`: the "ADR-0015 ... Tier A" line is gone (Tier A is epic #27261's term, not ADR-0015's); the ADR-0015 reference stays, describing what the ADR does govern on that page.

## Why

Contract review 6508089206 ④ on #27666: no must-fix, and none of these opens a path today, but each leaves the next caller a way to write a datasource the floor does not protect, or a contract that says two things about one member.

## Verification

Local, on `a5f0c8b5` (branch merged with `origin/main` at `34dc09b6`):

- New pins, each red with the fix reverted and green with it (reverse-verified from a committed state):
  - objectql `external-driver-floor.test.ts`, `[#27727]` block: `listDatasourceDefs` answers the named id, the kept id, and the manifest-declared id (2 of 3 red without the engine change; the third is the control that a def with no driver is listed without the key).
  - service-datasource `datasource-connection-service.test.ts`, `[#27727]` block: a `reconnect` without `previous` (and with an empty `driver`) rejects, the live driver and the def list are untouched, and the factory built nothing (red without the guard); a failed rebuild restores the kept pool under the OLD driver id. A `@ts-expect-error` pins `previous` as required in a file the package's `tsc` compiles.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 9247/9247. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-datasource test`: 1013/1013. cli `secret-reference-union` and `absent-table-reads`: 49/49.
- `typecheck` clean for objectql, service-datasource and spec; `pnpm lint` exit 0; spec `check:generated` exit 0 (all 14 artifacts current).
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 109 derived families, 109 run, 0 not measured, all exit 0 (after a full `pnpm build`).

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

The claim declared `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` for the required `previous`; the diff also widens `listDatasourceDefs`'s answer by the stored `driver` key, so this PR and its changeset say `yes (narrowing)`, as the epic PM asked. The changeset carries the BREAKING banner (a host calling `reconnect` without `previous`; none in-repo) and the ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.
